title: Apache Iceberg engine and catalog compatibility matrix

statuses.yes: Supported, per the product's own documentation or release notes.
statuses.partial: Supported with significant documented limits; the note says which.
statuses.read-only: Can read this feature but not write or create it.
statuses.no: The official documentation states it is not supported.
statuses.unknown: No official statement found. Not a guess either way.

engineFeatures.label: Write
engineFeatures.description: Writes to Iceberg tables (INSERT or append at minimum).

engineFeatures.label: Position deletes
engineFeatures.description: Merge-on-read position delete files, read and/or write.

engineFeatures.label: Equality deletes
engineFeatures.description: Equality delete files, read and/or write.

engineFeatures.label: Deletion vectors
engineFeatures.description: Format v3 deletion vectors stored in Puffin files.

engineFeatures.label: Format v3
engineFeatures.description: Format version 3 tables and their features (row lineage, variant, default values, geo types, nanosecond timestamps, deletion vectors).

engineFeatures.label: Branches and tags
engineFeatures.description: Create, query, and write to Iceberg branches and tags.

engineFeatures.label: REST catalog
engineFeatures.description: Connects to an Iceberg REST catalog.

engineFeatures.label: Iceberg views
engineFeatures.description: Reads and/or creates views stored in the Iceberg view format.

engineFeatures.label: Time travel
engineFeatures.description: Queries a table as of a snapshot ID or timestamp.

catalogFeatures.label: Serves REST API
catalogFeatures.description: Serves the Iceberg REST catalog API, so any REST client engine can connect.

catalogFeatures.label: Credential vending
catalogFeatures.description: Hands engines short-lived, scoped storage credentials.

catalogFeatures.label: Multi-table commits
catalogFeatures.description: Commits changes to several tables atomically (REST commitTransaction, or catalog-level commits and branches).

engines.name: Apache Spark (Iceberg Spark runtime)
engines.version: Iceberg 1.11.0 Spark runtime (Spark 3.5, 4.0, 4.1); docs/latest as of 2026-09-29

read.note: Batch SELECT and DataFrame reads, incremental reads, and metadata tables.

write.note: INSERT INTO, INSERT OVERWRITE, MERGE INTO, UPDATE, DELETE FROM and DataFrameWriterV2; CREATE TABLE, CTAS and RTAS via Spark DDL.

position_deletes.note: Row-level DELETE/UPDATE/MERGE write position deletes when write.*.mode is merge-on-read (v2+); needs Iceberg SQL extensions. Reads them.

equality_deletes.note: Reads equality deletes (1.11.0 fixed equality-delete reads with schema evolution); Spark writers produce position deletes or DVs, not equality deletes.

deletion_vectors.note: Writes DVs for v3 tables since 1.8.0; DVs surface in position_deletes metadata table; 1.9.0 rewrites v2 deletes to v3 DVs.

v3.note: Row lineage, DVs, variant (Spark 4.0+, shredded writes in 1.11) supported; nanosecond timestamps, geometry and geography not supported.

branching_tagging.note: CREATE/REPLACE/DROP BRANCH and TAG DDL, read via VERSION AS OF branch or tag, and writes to existing branches.

rest_catalog.note: Configure a catalog with spark.sql.catalog.<name>.type = rest and a REST uri.

views.note: CREATE, ALTER, DROP, SHOW and DESCRIBE Iceberg views on Spark 3.4 and above.

time_travel.note: SQL TIMESTAMP AS OF and VERSION AS OF (snapshot id, branch or tag) plus DataFrame read options.

engines.name: Apache Flink (Iceberg Flink connector)
engines.version: Iceberg 1.11.0 Flink runtime (Flink 1.20, 2.0, 2.1 jars); docs/latest as of 2026-09-29

read.note: Batch and streaming reads via SQL and DataStream (FLIP-27 source); streaming reads are append-only, CDC read not supported.

write.note: INSERT INTO, INSERT OVERWRITE, UPSERT and DataStream sinks incl. Dynamic Sink; CREATE TABLE via Flink DDL (no hidden partitioning).

position_deletes.note: No official statement found on reading or writing position delete files; docs cover UPSERT and delete-file metrics only.

equality_deletes.note: UPSERT mode writes row-level changes keyed on equality fields; needs v2+ table with primary key or identifier fields.

deletion_vectors.note: 1.11.0 added DV writing in IcebergSink and Dynamic Sink; DV read behavior not separately documented.

v3.note: Nanosecond timestamps, default values and row lineage readers supported; variant, geometry, geography listed as not supported in type mapping.

branching_tagging.note: Reads branches and tags (SQL options and DataStream) and writes to a branch via toBranch; no Flink DDL to create branches or tags.

rest_catalog.note: CREATE CATALOG with 'catalog-type'='rest' and a REST uri.

views.note: No official statement found; Flink docs do not cover Iceberg views.

time_travel.note: Batch-mode read options snapshot-id and as-of-timestamp, plus branch and tag options.

read.note: Reads Iceberg spec v1 and v2 tables in Parquet, ORC, or Avro; v3 support is experimental.

write.note: INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, TRUNCATE, MERGE, plus CREATE TABLE and CREATE TABLE AS.

position_deletes.note: Row-level DELETE/UPDATE/MERGE on v2 tables write position delete files; the connector also reads them.

equality_deletes.note: Release notes cover reading tables with equality delete files; no statement that Trino writes them.

deletion_vectors.note: $files exposes DV fields; 480 notes add deletes on v3 tables, but connector docs still say v3 row-level deletes are unsupported.

v3.note: Experimental. Notes 480-482 add v3 create/write/delete, row lineage, defaults, variant, nanosecond ts, geometry; connector page still lists v3 limits.

branching_tagging.note: Queries branches and tags via FOR VERSION AS OF; Trino 477 added CREATE/DROP/ALTER BRANCH SQL. Tag creation and branch writes not documented.

rest_catalog.note: iceberg.catalog.type=rest with OAuth2, SigV4, Google auth, and vended credentials (iceberg.rest-catalog.vended-credentials-enabled).

views.note: With the REST catalog, view management uses the Iceberg View specification; view endpoints enabled by default.

time_travel.note: FOR VERSION AS OF snapshot id, branch, or tag, and FOR TIMESTAMP AS OF.

engines.name: Dremio
engines.version: Dremio Cloud (docs and changelog as of 2026-09-22); Dremio Software docs current 26.x checked for limits

read.note: Iceberg is Dremio's native table format; reads v2 and v3 tables via Glue, REST, Snowflake Open Catalog, Unity Catalog.

write.note: Full DML (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, MERGE), CREATE TABLE/CTAS, schema evolution, OPTIMIZE on v2 and v3 tables.

position_deletes.note: DML defaults to copy-on-write; with write.*.mode=merge-on-read, v2 tables get position delete files, read and written.

equality_deletes.note: Reads equality deletes (Aug 2026 fix); Software 26.x docs say global unpartitioned equality deletes in v2 are not read.

deletion_vectors.note: Merge-on-read DML on v3 tables writes Puffin deletion vectors and reads them; v2 position deletes convert on first MOR write.

v3.note: Create, upgrade, read, write v3: DVs, variant, row lineage, default values (primitive only), nanosecond ts. Changelog marks v3 Preview.

branching_tagging.note: AT BRANCH/TAG/COMMIT refs are documented for versioned catalogs; Iceberg table-level branches and tags not documented.

rest_catalog.note: Connects to any Iceberg REST catalog (Polaris, Glue, S3 Tables, Nessie, OneLake, others) with optional vended credentials.

views.note: Reads Iceberg views from catalogs, choosing the Dremio dialect; Open Catalog stores views as Iceberg views.

time_travel.note: SELECT ... AT SNAPSHOT '<id>' or AT TIMESTAMP, limited by snapshot retention.

read.note: iceberg_scan reads tables directly from storage (read-only), or read via an attached Iceberg REST catalog.

write.note: Only through an attached REST catalog: CREATE TABLE/CTAS, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, MERGE INTO, ALTER TABLE.

position_deletes.note: Reads and writes positional deletes, merge-on-read only; no copy-on-write, and UPDATE/DELETE fail on sorted tables.

deletion_vectors.note: Reads and writes binary deletion vectors (Puffin) for v3 tables; DuckDB picks DVs automatically from format-version.

v3.note: Reads and writes v3: VARIANT, TIMESTAMP_NS, default values, DVs, row lineage. GEOGRAPHY and UNKNOWN types not yet supported.

rest_catalog.note: ATTACH ... (TYPE iceberg) to REST catalogs; docs say only S3, S3 Tables, and GCS storage backends are supported.

time_travel.note: AT (VERSION => snapshot_id) or AT (TIMESTAMP => ...) on catalog tables; snapshot_from_id/timestamp in iceberg_scan.

engines.name: Snowflake Apache Iceberg tables
engines.version: Snowflake docs as of 2026-09 (Snowflake-managed, externally managed, and catalog-linked database tables)

read.note: Queries Snowflake-managed and externally managed tables (catalog integration or catalog-linked database). Iceberg spec v1, v2 and v3 supported.

write.note: INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/MERGE/COPY on managed and external REST tables. Remote CREATE TABLE only via catalog-linked DB; external writes are autocommit only.

position_deletes.note: Reads and writes v2 position deletes for UPDATE/DELETE/MERGE. Docs limit this to externally managed tables; managed v2 defaults to copy-on-write.

equality_deletes.note: Row-level equality deletes are listed as unsupported; Horizon IRC also rejects equality deletes from external engines.

deletion_vectors.note: Writes DVs for DELETE/UPDATE/MERGE on v3 tables (managed and external); merge-on-read is default for v3. Heuristics may fall back to copy-on-write.

v3.note: v3 create/read/write: variant, geo types, ns timestamps, unknown, defaults, DVs, row lineage. No multi-arg transforms, encryption keys, or in-place upgrade.

branching_tagging.note: No Snowflake SQL for Iceberg branches or tags is documented; Horizon catalog limits state creating Iceberg tags and branches isn't supported.

rest_catalog.note: Catalog integration for any Iceberg REST catalog (OAuth, bearer/PAT, SigV4, vended credentials); catalog-linked databases auto-discover and write tables.

views.note: No official statement found on reading or creating Iceberg-spec views; Snowflake views over Iceberg tables are Snowflake objects.

time_travel.note: Snowflake Time Travel within retention period. External tables: snapshots after table creation, if refreshed before the snapshot expires.

engines.name: Google BigQuery (Iceberg managed tables, Lakehouse runtime catalog, external tables)
engines.version: BigQuery and Lakehouse docs as of 2026-09 (BigLake names now Iceberg managed tables and Lakehouse runtime catalog)

read.note: Reads Iceberg managed tables, Lakehouse runtime catalog tables, and Iceberg external tables (v2, v3 in Preview). Parquet only.

write.note: Full DML on BigQuery-managed Iceberg tables (GA). DDL/DML on Lakehouse runtime catalog tables is Preview, v2 only. External tables are read-only.

position_deletes.note: Reads merge-on-read position deletes (up to 10,000 delete files per data file). BigQuery writes only support copy-on-write.

equality_deletes.note: Reads equality deletes on external tables, max 100,000 equality deletes per data file. No documented equality delete writes.

deletion_vectors.note: Preview: BigQuery reads binary DVs on v3 tables; BigQuery writes to v3 tables aren't supported (use Spark, Flink or Trino).

v3.note: Preview, read-only from BigQuery: DVs only. New v3 types, default values, row lineage and encryption keys are not supported.

branching_tagging.note: No official statement found on BigQuery querying or creating branches or tags; docs only note snapshot expiry is skipped when refs exist.

rest_catalog.note: Uses Google Lakehouse runtime catalog (Iceberg REST). Remote REST catalogs (Glue, Unity, Horizon, Workday) only via cross-cloud federation (Preview).

views.note: The Lakehouse runtime catalog doesn't support Apache Iceberg views.

time_travel.note: FOR SYSTEM_TIME AS OF on external table snapshots; BigQuery time travel limited to 7 days on managed and runtime catalog tables.

engines.name: Amazon Athena
engines.version: Athena engine version 3 (Iceberg library 1.4.2), docs as of 2026-09

read.note: SELECT on Iceberg v2 tables in AWS Glue Data Catalog, including S3 Tables; Parquet, ORC and Avro data files.

write.note: CREATE TABLE, CTAS, INSERT INTO, UPDATE, DELETE, MERGE INTO. Creates v2 tables only; DDL not supported on Lake Formation registered tables.

position_deletes.note: Reads position deletes; UPDATE, DELETE and MERGE always write position delete files (merge-on-read). Copy-on-write isn't supported.

equality_deletes.note: Queries merge-on-read both position and equality deletes; Athena writes only position deletes.

deletion_vectors.note: Athena only creates and operates on Iceberg v2 tables, so v3 deletion vectors are not supported.

v3.note: Athena only creates and operates on Iceberg v2 tables; Iceberg library version is 1.4.2.

branching_tagging.note: No official statement found on branch or tag create, query or write; only the $refs metadata table is documented.

rest_catalog.note: Only Iceberg tables in the AWS Glue Data Catalog are supported (S3 Tables via Glue catalog registration); no generic REST catalog connection.

views.note: Views listed as unsupported for Iceberg: use Athena CREATE VIEW instead; Iceberg view specification not supported.

time_travel.note: FOR TIMESTAMP AS OF and FOR VERSION AS OF (snapshot ID) in engine version 3.

read.note: Queries v1 and v2 tables in Parquet and ORC via Iceberg catalogs (Hive metastore, Glue, REST, JDBC, others).

write.note: CREATE TABLE, INSERT INTO/OVERWRITE (v3.1+), DELETE (v4.1+), TRUNCATE. UPDATE and MERGE not documented.

position_deletes.note: Reads v2 position deletes (v3.0/v3.1+); v4.1.0 added writing position delete files for DELETE.

equality_deletes.note: Queries on v2 tables support equality deletes from v3.1.10/v3.2.5/v3.3 (Parquet); no write support documented.

v3.note: v4.1 adds v3 default values, row lineage (_row_id reads), VARIANT; unsupported v3 features fail fast. DVs, geometry, ns ts not documented.

branching_tagging.note: Beta: CREATE/DROP BRANCH and TAG, INSERT INTO a branch, and query branch or tag with VERSION AS OF.

rest_catalog.note: iceberg.catalog.type=rest, with vended credentials from v4.0 and view endpoints enabled by default.

views.note: CREATE VIEW makes Iceberg views (v3.5+); ALTER VIEW adds a StarRocks dialect to existing Iceberg views.

time_travel.note: Beta since v3.4: VERSION AS OF snapshot id, branch, or tag, and TIMESTAMP AS OF datetime or date.

read.note: table.scan() with row filters and projections into Arrow, pandas, DuckDB, Polars, Ray, Daft and others.

write.note: create_table, append, overwrite (with filter), delete and upsert via PyArrow; streaming RecordBatchReader writes only for unpartitioned tables.

position_deletes.note: Reads position deletes (DeleteFileIndex, 0.11.0); delete() warns merge-on-read is not yet supported and falls back to copy-on-write.

equality_deletes.note: Code raises 'PyIceberg does not yet support equality deletes' when equality delete files are encountered.

deletion_vectors.note: Deletion Vectors read support added in 0.10.0; writes use copy-on-write, so no DVs are produced.

v3.note: Reads v3; has row lineage fields, DV reads, nanosecond, default and geo types. Nanosecond writes in v3 not implemented; v3 metadata JSON write raises.

branching_tagging.note: manage_snapshots() creates branches and tags; writes to branches (WAP example) and fast-forward supported.

rest_catalog.note: REST catalog configuration with OAuth, SigV4 and custom headers.

views.note: create_view, load_view, list, exists and drop on REST catalogs; view support tied to the REST catalog.

time_travel.note: table.scan(snapshot_id=...) and snapshot_as_of_timestamp(); metadata tables accept snapshot_id.

rest_api.note: Defines the REST catalog API: config, namespaces, tables, views, scan planning, metrics, signing and credentials endpoints

views.note: Defines list, create, load, replace, rename, drop and register view endpoints

v3_tables.note: TableMetadata allows format-version 1 through 3; update types include upgrade-format-version and row lineage fields

credential_vending.note: Defines X-Iceberg-Access-Delegation (vended-credentials, remote-signing), storage-credentials and a table credentials endpoint

multi_table_commits.note: Defines POST /v1/{prefix}/transactions/commit to commit updates to multiple tables atomically; servers may omit it

rest_api.note: Built on the Iceberg REST protocol; any REST-compatible engine can read and write Polaris-managed tables

views.note: Polaris view entities map to Iceberg views, managed through the REST CreateView/LoadView APIs

v3_tables.note: No official statement found on format v3 support in the 1.8.0 docs or release notes

credential_vending.note: Returns short-lived, scoped storage credentials on table or view load for S3, Azure ADLS and GCS

multi_table_commits.note: Implements the REST commitTransaction endpoint; release notes cover commitTransaction fixes and retryable 409 conflicts

catalogs.name: AWS Glue Data Catalog
catalogs.version: AWS Glue docs as of 2026-09 (Iceberg REST endpoint; Glue 6.0 for v3)

rest_api.note: Serves Iceberg REST at glue.<region>.amazonaws.com/iceberg with SigV4; single-level namespaces, no staged create (CTAS)

views.note: Docs state View APIs in the Iceberg REST spec are not supported; Glue has its own multi-dialect Data Catalog views

v3_tables.note: Glue 6.0 Spark jobs create or upgrade v3 tables (variant, nanosecond timestamps, geo); REST endpoint page lists only v1 and v2

credential_vending.note: Lake Formation vends temporary credentials to external engines once full table access for external engines is enabled

multi_table_commits.note: CommitTransaction is absent from the documented list of supported Iceberg REST operations

catalogs.name: Hive Metastore
catalogs.version: Iceberg 1.11.0 HiveCatalog; Hive 4.x Metastore Iceberg REST (Hive 4.2.1 latest)

rest_api.note: HiveCatalog itself uses Thrift, but Hive 4.x Metastore also serves Iceberg REST endpoints (default port 9001 in Docker images)

views.note: View support for the Hive catalog added in Iceberg 1.7.0; HMS REST endpoint list includes view operations

v3_tables.note: No official statement found; Hive engine Iceberg docs only describe v1 and v2 tables. The catalog stores a metadata pointer; the writing engine sets the format version.

credential_vending.note: No official statement found; the HMS REST endpoint list shows no credentials endpoint

multi_table_commits.note: HMS Iceberg REST advertises POST /v1/{prefix}/transactions/commit in its /v1/config endpoint list

rest_api.note: Serves Iceberg REST, which Nessie labels experimental; Nessie manages table and view metadata

views.note: Versions Iceberg views alongside tables on branches

v3_tables.note: Release notes state Iceberg table spec v3 is not supported (0.103.0); no later statement found

credential_vending.note: Provides short-lived, down-scoped credentials or S3 request signing via Iceberg REST; GCS downscoping fixed in 0.108.8

multi_table_commits.note: Cross-table transactions via single commits touching many tables, or via branches merged atomically

catalogs.name: Unity Catalog
catalogs.version: Databricks Unity Catalog docs as of 2026-09 (DBR 18 LTS+ for v3); OSS Unity Catalog 0.6.0 differs

rest_api.note: Databricks serves Iceberg REST at /api/2.1/unity-catalog/iceberg-rest (read and write managed Iceberg). OSS UC 0.6.0 only reads UniForm tables

views.note: Databricks docs: external Iceberg clients can't access views

v3_tables.note: Managed tables support v3 DVs, variant, row lineage, geo types, write defaults; not initial defaults, unknown type, nanosecond timestamps

credential_vending.note: Vends short-lived credentials via Iceberg REST: read/write/create for managed Iceberg, read-only for foreign Iceberg

multi_table_commits.note: Multi-table SQL transactions on Databricks compute; Iceberg table support is Private Preview. No REST commitTransaction documented

rest_api.note: A client-side catalog library: each engine connects to the database itself. It does not serve the REST API.

views.note: View support added in Iceberg 1.5.0; requires jdbc.schema-version=V1 in catalog properties

v3_tables.note: No official statement found on format v3 for the JDBC catalog. The catalog stores a metadata pointer; the writing engine sets the format version.

credential_vending.note: No official statement found; docs cover only JDBC connection settings

multi_table_commits.note: No official statement found; docs describe atomic single-table commits via database transactions
